# KinetiRx (Pharma Care Pro)

> Self-hosted pharmacy and small-clinic management by NodeDR: billing, batch and expiry stock, patient records, dues and OPD scheduling. Has a JWT-authenticated REST API and a local stdio MCP server. No scoped API keys or webhooks: not suited to public-website integration. Handles sensitive patient data.
